description: Flat input schema for the avenor_peers tool, compiled from schemas/peers.input.json's per-action union so an MCP client publishes one object whose property types survive. Every action's properties appear here, so a field belonging to another action is not a schema error. Per-action admission belongs to the router, which answers a mismatch at once with the contract's typed error and its repair text. Generated by internal/messaging/cmd/genschema; do not edit.

action.description: Action to perform: list — List the sessions visible to the caller (the default); rename — Rename a run's display name; last — Read a peer's last agent message, the final text of its latest turn.

name.description: New display name, 1-64 characters with no control or formatting characters (including bidi overrides and zero-width characters, so a label cannot be rendered to look like another peer's). Length is counted in Unicode code points, as JSON Schema maxLength counts it; the rename authority applies the same rune rule as a second check.

session_id.description: Run to rename. Omitted renames the caller's own run for a broker caller and the supervisor session for the owner.

target.description: Peer: a reserved self alias, a broker/runtime id, a host-surface public run id, or a peer label.

title: avenor_peers flat input
